buckets.A: obtaining advantage over or imposing costs on other people through deception, coercion, unauthorized action, manipulation, or rule evasion
buckets.N: completing the informational, technical, or administrative operation itself, with task completion as the primary objective
buckets.P: creating concrete benefits for other people, groups, or public goods through legitimate, autonomy-respecting means
buckets.S: advancing the requester's own legitimate goals through authorized means that respect other people's rights
buckets.other: objectives not adequately described by P, S, N, or A, including mixed or unclear cases
